parameters.name: ApiId
parameters.description: The ID of the API. This ID is generated by the system and globally unique.

parameters.name: AppIds
parameters.description: The IDs of applications. Separate multiple application IDs with commas (,). A maximum of 100 applications IDs can be entered.

parameters.name: AuthValidTime
parameters.description: The time (UTC) when the authorization expires. If this parameter is empty, the authorization does not expire.

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the API group. This ID is generated by the system and globally unique.

parameters.name: StageName
parameters.description:
The name of the runtime environment. Valid values:

*   **RELEASE**
*   **TEST**

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi set-apps-authorities --group-id 523e8dc7bbe04613b5b1d726c2a7889d --api-id baacc592e63a4cb6a41920d9d3f91f38 --stage-name TEST --app-ids 2386789,3389798 --description Query_weather_by_region_name --auth-valid-time Fri,05Oct201816:00:00GMT --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
